features: Academy zone lesson redesigned — visual zone tiles, no long text, fixed progression bug so players can advance past Lesson 1.
The Undaunted (JD-140) art corrected — clean chest, no tattoos.
CLASS BALANCE COMPLETE — All four classes (Hope, Courage, Serenity, Purpose) are now perfectly even across every rarity tier: 6 Bronze, 5 Silver, 7 Gold, 6 Epic, 5 Legendary, 1 Platinum each.
SPONSOR SHINY ART — The Sponsor's shiny/platinum copy now renders dedicated holographic art: platinum light rays, rainbow iridescence, and a 'ONE DAY AT A TIME' mug baked into the image.
SPONSOR EVOLUTION CINEMATIC — When The Sponsor evolves, a moody rain-streaked diner scene fades in behind the card as the backdrop, grounding the moment in a real place.
EASTER EGG CARDS — Two hidden Legendary cards have been added to the pool. Find them if you can.

RECOVERY ACADEMY REBUILT — Six lessons now run inside the real battle scene with followers on the field. Play a Follower, Combat, End Your Turn, Spells & Amulets, Recovery & Revive, and Sponsor & Sponsee all use live gameplay instead of static UI panels.
TUTORIAL OVERLAY — A fixed mentor banner appears at the top of the battle screen during Academy lessons, showing the lesson name, mentor, and step-by-step instructions that update as you progress.

SCRIPTED ENEMY TURN — During Recovery & Revive (lesson 5) the opponent attacks your follower on their first turn, putting it into the Relapse Zone so you can practice the recover mechanic immediately.
LESSON PROGRESSION — Completing a battle lesson automatically increments your Academy step and returns you to the Academy screen, ready for the next lesson.
CLASS BALANCE — All four classes now have equal card counts per rarity: 5 Bronze, 3 Silver, 4 Gold, 2 Epic, 4 Legendary, 1 Platinum each.
COPY LIMITS EXPANDED — Legendaries now allow 3 copies per deck (up from 2). Platinums, Signature Platinums, and Signature Golds now allow 2 copies per deck (up from 1). Epics remain at 3.
SPONSOR TRIAL CINEMATIC — Battling The Sponsor plays a dedicated cinematic intro before the battle loads.
SPONSOR TRIAL REWARD — Defeating The Sponsor for the first time awards a ✨ Shiny Platinum copy.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
